يستحملون (form X)
# يَسْتَحْمِلُونَ (yastaḥmilūna) /jas.taħ.mi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
# يُسْتَحْمَلُونَ (yustaḥmalūna) /jus.taħ.ma.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
